name: Turkey, Artichoke, Dill & Feta Stuffed Peppers with Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 yellow bell peppers
½ small bunch fresh dill
½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are tender and charred, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
½ medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and onion; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add ground turkey and spices to the skillet; continue to cook, breaking the turkey apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb ground turkey
¼ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the turkey is cooking, using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet with the cooked turkey.
Mince olives and artichokes; add both to the skillet along with half the feta (reserving the rest for topping the peppers). Stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
½ (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Divide turkey filling between pepper halves and top with reserved feta. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
2 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp red wine vinegar
⅛ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper
1 pinch oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: Mince walnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the spinach; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
